items.title: Could Advanced Micro Devices (AMD)’s Partnership With Cisco Systems (CSCO) Unlock a Massive Middle East AI Opportunity?
items.summary: On August 31, Advanced Micro Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ:AMD), Cisco Systems, Inc. (NASDAQ:CSCO), and Humain announced that their joint AI infrastructure buildout in Saudi Arabia is officially live. The deployment links AMD’s Instinct MI355X GPUs and EPYC CPUs directly with Cisco’s Silicon One-based 800G switches, giving Humain a foundation to offer GPU-as-a-service across the Middle East. […]
